run_assess_baseline: run the assess command to evaluate baseline job performance and collect system metrics
run_instrument_pipeline: run the instrument pipeline function to add TTFB and step-time logging to a script
extract_code_block: extract the last Python code block from an agent response using regex matching
parse_args_assess: parse command line arguments for the assess command including workdir and baseline job
run_assess_skip_instrument: run the assess command with skip-instrument flag to skip automatic pipeline instrumentation
